theme: Indus object identity, context, source and rights ledger
question: Can a 200-carrier local pilot connect corpus faces, source-qualified aliases, museum records and archaeological context while preserving missingness and conflicting assertions?
outcome: Preserved original 200-object selection and added hash-ordered selection: 34 versus 39 export site labels, 18 versus 44 Lower Indus carriers, zero versus 10 Kalibangan. Corrected original dimension completeness 127 to 130, gain 3. Original 149 excavation strings restated as 126 uncontaminated registrations; citations, lots and variants separated. Revised registers have 6991 and 7004 assertions; museum joins 26 and 25, candidates 34 and 15. All 26 reviewer mutations and 17 sequence fixtures caught;23 result files replay exactly; original 158 checks pass. No real Helsinki imports or dating-sample links.
challenge: Alphabetical sample bias; ambiguous export registrations; source/date/count disagreements; surface concordance unavailable; metadata rights unresolved for public release.
remedy: Dated exploratory amendment, hash-ordered strata, country-qualified external quota, source-qualified corrections, schema 2 and semantic validator, local-only replays, occurrence-aware Helsinki adapter and specific review queues.
retry_when: Reviewed object/surface concordances, confirmed inscription eligibility, new primary registration/date evidence or a public reuse basis become available; add a new endpoint.
